field_changes.old: Logging your sets just got more fluid — hitting Done on the keyboard now instantly logs the set and dismisses the keyboard in one go, so nothing breaks your workout rhythm. Plus a handful of bug fixes along the way.
field_changes.new: Adaptive Plans now offer a 7-day free trial — try personalized programming before you commit. The Progress Index has a fresh redesign with new charts, cards, and a how-to-read walkthrough. Injuries you mark now sync to your adaptive plan so your program reflects your actual training state, and weight predictions snap to equipment increments for cleaner logging. Plus a handful of bug fixes along the way.
